title: Gideon Learns to Trust
summary: God sees what He can do through us even when we feel weak. God used Gideon even though he felt weak and afraid. When you feel too small for what is right, Gideon's story shows that God can work through people who know they need help.

read_it.prompt: Read Judges 6:11-16. Watch for what the story shows about trust.

tell_it: God used Gideon even though he felt weak and afraid. Gideon felt small and afraid. God called him a mighty man of valor and promised to be with him. The pressure in the scene helps the lesson feel real.
understand_it: The point is not that Gideon Learns to Trust is impressive by itself. God sees what He can do through us even when we feel weak. When you feel too small for what is right, Gideon's story shows that God can work through people who know they need help.
age_5_7_explanation: God used Gideon even though he felt weak and afraid.
age_8_11_explanation: Gideon felt small and afraid. God called him a mighty man of valor and promised to be with him. Kids can practice retelling it with the beginning, hard moment, and God-centered ending.
teen_explanation: God sees what He can do through us even when we feel weak. A teen discussion can press into why the story mattered then and how the same truth can reshape choices now.
key_truths: God sees what He can do through us even when we feel weak.
Gideon Learns to Trust shows trust through a real Bible moment, not a slogan.
When you feel too small for what is right, Gideon's story shows that God can work through people who know they need help.
life_application: When you feel too small for what is right, Gideon's story shows that God can work through people who know they need help.

quiz_questions.question: Which answer keeps Gideon Learns to Trust connected to the actual passage?
quiz_questions.explanation: I will be with you is the story detail to remember. The bigger lesson grows out of that detail instead of floating away from the passage.

quiz_questions.question: What is one wise response to Gideon Learns to Trust?
quiz_questions.answer: When you feel too small for what is right, Gideon's story shows that God can work through people who know they need help.
quiz_questions.explanation: The lesson should move from hearing to response. God sees what He can do through us even when we feel weak.

memory_verse.prompt: Use Judges 6:16 as the verse anchor for Gideon Learns to Trust.

discussion_questions: Who needed help, courage, correction, or mercy in Gideon Learns to Trust?
What truth should a kid remember after reading Gideon Learns to Trust?
How can the group pray about Gideon Learns to Trust without using pretend-perfect answers?

activity.title: Torch and Jar Signal
activity.instructions: Make a paper torch and jar, then talk about how God used a surprising plan.

prayer_prompt: Lord, use Gideon Learns to Trust to teach my heart, not just my memory. Help me take one faithful next step after reading Gideon Learns to Trust.
